title: The PRISM Alignment Dataset: What Participatory, Representative and Individualised Human Feedback Reveals About the Subjective and Multicultural Alignment of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes 'Religion & Spirituality' and 'Ethics of Death and Killing' as key topic clusters used to evaluate and benchmark LLM alignment. It also treats 'Religion' as a core demographic identifier to analyze how spiritual backgrounds influence human feedback and model preferences on value-laden issues.
